name: jcgrading-paving-solution-site
description: Static marketing site for JC Grading Paving Solution, Inc., deployed to Cloudflare Workers Static Assets. This package.json exists to compile the production Tailwind CSS build (assets/css/tailwind.build.css) and to run wrangler — nothing here executes at request time. node_modules is build-only and is excluded from the deployed assets via .assetsignore.
